##### Project general facts

W The Residences by Arada is an exclusive waterfront collection of branded homes set across a striking three-tower formation, created with the lifestyle brand W. The towers share a nine-level podium with parking, amenities and a grand lobby, each rising to forty-one residential floors and a roof level, with architecture that merges contemporary elegance with the calm of the sea. The collection offers one- to five-bedroom apartments, duplexes and expansive penthouses, the most exclusive of them crowned with private pools and wraparound terraces with sweeping views.

Residents enjoy one of the longest infinity pools in the city, a state-of-the-art gym, a wellness spa and a yoga and stretching studio. A private cinema, a dedicated music recording studio, a rooftop lounge, a barbecue area, meeting and co-working spaces and a children's play area add variety, while on-site restaurants and retail, round-the-clock concierge and signature W hospitality services make everyday life effortless for residents and their guests.

Interiors combine smart home integration with high-end finishes and generous, flowing layouts, while floor-to-ceiling glazing frames views of the sea, the marina and the skyline. Premium materials and a refined contemporary palette run through every room. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fully equipped kitchens and built-in appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Harbour is a premier waterfront district between Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, home to one of the largest marinas in the region, a cruise terminal and a skyline of contemporary towers. Waterfront promenades, beaches, restaurants and yacht berths create a vibrant resort atmosphere, while the area combines residential, hospitality and leisure destinations in a single, walkable setting.

Sheikh Zayed Road and King Salman Bin Abdulaziz Al Saud Street connect residents with the wider city, while the Dubai Tram and metro stations are close by. Palm Jumeirah, Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach Residence and Bluewaters Island with Ain Dubai are a short drive away, Dubai Media City and Dubai Internet City are nearby, and Downtown Dubai and both international airports are within comfortable reach.

Dubai Harbour is a freehold district open to international buyers and one of the most sought-after waterfront addresses in Dubai. Branded residences linked to a global hospitality name attract high-net-worth buyers and premium tenants, while the marina, beaches and proximity to Palm Jumeirah support strong demand for luxury rentals and holiday homes, underpinning long-term value for owners.
